preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) and all(isinstance(cell, int) and cell in {0, 1} for cell in row) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The input grid is a 2D list of integers where each cell is either 0 (sea) or 1 (land).
The grid is non-empty and has at least one row and one column.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[i][j] == 1 and not any(is_boundary_reachable(grid, i, j, len(grid), len(grid[0]))))
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of land cells (1s) that cannot reach the grid boundary through any sequence of adjacent land cells (4-directional moves).
